pokedexEntries.go: To keep from being blown away by the wind, they gather in clusters. They do enjoy gentle breezes, though.

pokedexEntries.si: Its body is so light, it must grip the ground firmly with its feet to keep from being blown away.

pokedexEntries.cr: It can be carried away on even the gentlest breeze. It may even float all the way to the next town.

pokedexEntries.rs: This POKéMON drifts and floats with the wind. If it senses the approach of strong winds, HOPPIP links its leaves with other HOPPIP to prepare against being blown away.

pokedexEntries.fr: Its body is so light, it must grip the ground firmly with its feet to keep from being blown away.

pokedexEntries.em: This POKéMON drifts and floats with the wind. If it senses the approach of strong winds, a HOPPIP links leaves with others to prepare against being blown away.

pokedexEntries.dpp: It drifts on winds. It is said that when HOPPIP gather in fields and mountains, spring is on the way.
